concerns.text: Spec FR‑002 requires clustering descriptors to be computed *within the interface region of the GB supercell*. The plan amends this to compute descriptors on the bulk configuration before impurity insertion (see “Descriptor Timing” amendment). This deviates from the written requirement and leaves FR‑002 unfulfilled as stated.

Spec FR‑011 mandates validation of EAM‑derived segregation‑energy labels against a DFT benchmark (≥30 samples, MAE ≤ 0.1 eV). The plan marks this requirement as waived due to lack of an open benchmark, resulting in no actual validation being performed.
Success Criterion SC‑006 expects the validation (FR‑011) to achieve MAE ≤ 0.1 eV. Since FR‑011 is waived, SC‑006 cannot be satisfied, leaving the criterion uncovered.
